body.name: \mathfrak{H}_{P}
body.construction: Starting from the causal bilinear residual identity in a window of radius \(h_n^*\) about \(x_0\), partition the window at multiple distance resolutions, select bounded close pairs or tuples with explicit empty-cell fallbacks, and choose a finite signed combination whose vanishing moments separately annihilate the lower Taylor terms of \(\pi_P\) and \(\mu_{0,P}\). Fit the remaining local \(R\)-projection at rank \(k_n^*\), clip all normalizations and the final estimate to \([-2L,2L]\), and derive the correction order, scales, weights, collision accounting, and enlarged validity region in \(\mathrm{oeq:multiresolution\mbox{-}order\mbox{-}frontier}\). No candidate order or weight vector is presupposed.
